body:
I last tested [this commit](https://git.filmroellchen.eu/filmroellchen/penplot/commit/6644b23f76639fca13e653fd191aab8a6082f112) in December 2025 with nightly 2025-12-04 (or thereabouts), which compiled. My specific command line was `RUSTFLAGS="-Z stack-protector=all -C link-arg=-Tlinkall.x -C link-arg=-Tdefmt.x -C force-frame-pointers -Z threads=20 " DEFMT_LOG="debug,esp_rtos=info,penplot=trace" cargo run -Z unstable-options -Zprofile-hint-mostly-unused --package penplot`, aka. with the parallel front-end.

After upgrading to nightly 2026-03-17, instead, the query recursion limit is hit here:

```
error: queries overflow the depth limit!
  |
  = help: consider increasing the recursion limit by adding a `#![recursion_limit = "256"]` attribute to your crate (`penplot`)
  = note: query depth increased by 130 when computing layout of `embassy_executor::raw::TaskPool<<() as web::web_task::_EmbassyInternalTaskTrait>::Fut, #[embassy_executor::task(pool_size = WEB_TASK_POOL_SIZE + WEB_TASK_POOL_SIZE_AP)]>`
```

From the existing issues, I assumed this was a parallel frontend bug, but that’s not the case, the same exact output happens with `RUSTFLAGS="-Z stack-protector=all -C link-arg=-Tlinkall.x -C link-arg=-Tdefmt.x -C force-frame-pointers" DEFMT_LOG="debug,esp_rtos=info,penplot=trace" cargo run --package penplot` as well (pretty much the minimal command line that shouldn’t change codegen).

Following the compiler’s suggestion fixes the issue and produces correct code.

It seems like this hasn’t been reported for embassy’s futures specifically, but GitHub’s search is not good enough for me to double-check. Apologies if this is a duplicate otherwise, as per the previous sentence I couldn’t find anything that’s quite exactly the same (also nothing that’s both still open and not only caused by the parallel frontend).
